subject.title: chore(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 4 updates

question: Should these four updates land together after exact-head CI and signed packaged-app smoke, or should Peekaboo 3.7.1 be split into a dedicated validation PR?
rationale: The source update is mechanically correct and upstream API inspection found no concrete break, but the appropriate runtime proof depth for the production updater and UI-automation dependency remains a macOS owner judgment.

options.title: Validate the group
options.body: Keep all four updates together and merge after exact-head macOS checks and signed packaged-runtime smoke pass.

options.title: Split Peekaboo
options.body: Land the routine library updates separately and validate Peekaboo 3.7.1 with dedicated bridge, permissions, and computer-action smoke.

recommendation.title: Validate the group
recommendation.body: Keep all four updates together and merge after exact-head macOS checks and signed packaged-runtime smoke pass.
